propositions: Add an advisory LLM criterion no-file-impact that judges whether a ticket's file_impact_scope: none assertion is correct by determining if the plan actually requires repository file changes
Route no-file-impact into Pass-1 selection only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly the string 'none'; other values (paths, undeclared, missing, None, unknown) must not incur LLM evaluation
Carry the persisted no_file_impact_reason field into the Pass-1 request as a deterministic structured context block with JSON serialization, preserving special characters and Unicode

Define the criterion's rubric sub-answers (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) such that each field drives the final advisory verdict: pass when both repository-file changes are absent and reason is grounded; contradiction when files or required deliverables are named; insufficient coaching when evidence is too vague

Tests must verify observable public contracts (routing applicability, prompt payload structure, CLI explain, advisory aggregation) using real criterion selection and orchestration paths, not private source text or implementation shape
